-- [[ AXZ ULTIMATE V8 - PERFECT LAYOUT & COLORS BY SEISHIRO ]] --

if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
while not LocalPlayer do
    task.wait(0.1)
    LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
end

if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("AXZ_MainGui") then CoreGui.AXZ_MainGui:Destroy() end

-- Global State Variables
_G.Target = ""
_G.TargetPlayerObj = nil
_G.BangSpeed = 35
_G.BangIntensity = 1.5
_G.OrbitSpeed = 15
_G.OrbitDistance = 5

-- Feature Toggles
_G.IsNormalBanging = false
_G.IsFaceBanging = false
_G.IsHeadSitting = false
_G.IsBackSitting = false
_G.IsOrbiting = false
_G.IsMapOrbiting = false

-- Protection Flags
_G.AntiSit = false
_G.AntiVoid = false
_G.AntiFling = false
_G.AntiBring = false
_G.AntiFreeze = false
_G.AntiRagdoll = false
_G.AntiBlind = false

-- Theme Preset Definitions (Dark background)
local CurrentTheme = "Dark"
local RainbowConnection = nil

local ThemeColors = {
    Dark = {
        Bg = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18), 
        Header = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 28), 
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 34), 
        Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 60),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    },
    Blue = {
        Bg = Color3.fromRGB(10, 18, 32), 
        Header = Color3.fromRGB(15, 28, 50), 
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(20, 35, 60), 
        Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 200),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    },
    Green = {
        Bg = Color3.fromRGB(10, 26, 16), 
        Header = Color3.fromRGB(16, 42, 26), 
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(22, 54, 34), 
        Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(30, 150, 70),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    },
    Red = {
        Bg = Color3.fromRGB(28, 12, 14), 
        Header = Color3.fromRGB(45, 18, 22), 
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(58, 24, 28), 
        Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(180, 30, 40),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    },
    Yellow = {
        Bg = Color3.fromRGB(28, 24, 12), 
        Header = Color3.fromRGB(45, 38, 18),

    },
    Rainbow = {
        Bg = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18), 
        Header = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 28), 
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 34), 
        Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    }
}

-------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GUI CREATION
-------------------------------------------------------------------

MainGui.Name = "AXZ_MainGui"

-- Main Frame

-- Header Bar

local Tabs = {}

local CardFrames = {}

local function createTab(name)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", TabContainer)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 1, 0)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, #Tabs * 80, 0, 0)
    btn.Text = name
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 11
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 34)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", ContentArea)
    page.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    page.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    page.Visible = false

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, t in pairs(Tabs) do
            t.Page.Visible = false
            t.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 34)
            t.Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
        end
        page.Visible = true
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    end)

    table.insert(Tabs, {Button = btn, Page = page})
    if #Tabs == 1 then
        page.Visible = true
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    end
    return page
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------
-- DYNAMIC THEME ENGINE
-------------------------------------------------------------------
local function applyTheme(themeName)
    CurrentTheme = themeName
    local theme = ThemeColors[themeName]

    if RainbowConnection then RainbowConnection:Disconnect() RainbowConnection = nil end

    if themeName == "Rainbow" then
        RainbowConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local hue = (tick() % 5) / 5
            local rainbowColor = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
            TitleLabel.TextColor3 = rainbowColor
            FrameStroke.Color = rainbowColor
        end)
    else
        ModernFrame.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Bg
        HeaderBar.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Header
        FrameStroke.Color = theme.Stroke
        TitleLabel.TextColor3 = theme.Text
    end

    for _, card in ipairs(CardFrames) do
        if card and card.Parent then
            card.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Card
        end
    end

    for name, item in pairs(ThemeUIElements) do
        if name == themeName then
            item.StatusBtn.Text = "ACTIVE"
            item.StatusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            item.StatusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        else
            item.StatusBtn.Text = "SELECT"
            item.StatusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
            item.StatusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
        end
    end
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TAB 1: [HOME TAB - WITH TARGET TOOL]
-------------------------------------------------------------------

homeLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)

-- Give Target Tool (Home Tab-e shifting)

-- Themes Section

-------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GENERAL SLIDER CREATOR
-------------------------------------------------------------------
local function createSlider(parent, title, min, max, default, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 44)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = ThemeColors.Dark.Card
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    table.insert(CardFrames, frame)

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 16)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 4)
    lbl.Text = title .. ": " .. tostring(default)
    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    lbl.TextSize = 11
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    local barBg = Instance.new("Frame", frame)
    barBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 8)
    barBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 26)
    barBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    Instance.new("UICorner", barBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    local fillBar = Instance.new("Frame", barBg)
    fillBar.Size = UDim2.new((default - min)/(max - min), 0, 1, 0)
    fillBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Instance.new("UICorner", fillBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    local dragging = false
    local function update(input)
        local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - barBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / barBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local val = math.floor(min + (max - min) * pos)
        fillBar.Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.Text = title .. ": " .. tostring(val)
        callback(val)
    end

    barBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    return frame
end

local TargetUser = Instance.new("TextLabel", TargetCard)

TargetUser.Text = "@target..."

TargetUser.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham

local function updateTargetProfile(plr)
    _G.TargetPlayerObj = plr
    _G.Target = plr.Name
    TargetName.Text = plr.DisplayName
    TargetUser.Text = "@" .. plr.Name
    local content, isLoaded = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(plr.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100)
    if isLoaded then TargetAvatar.Image = content end
end
_G.UpdateTargetProfileGlobal = updateTargetProfile

TargetSearch:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local name = TargetSearch.Text:lower()
    if #name > 0 then
        for _, v in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if v ~= LocalPlayer and (v.Name:lower():sub(1, #name) == name or v.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #name) == name) then
                updateTargetProfile(v)
                break
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- 3. Bang Action Grid Buttons (BELOW SEARCH & PROFILE)
local GridFrame = Instance.new("Frame", TargetPage)
GridFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 95)
GridFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local gridLayout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout", GridFrame)
gridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 0, 42)
gridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0, 8)

local bangAnimTrack = nil

local function resetTargetStates()
    _G.IsNormalBanging = false
    _G.IsFaceBanging = false
    _G.IsHeadSitting = false
    _G.IsBackSitting = false
    if bangAnimTrack then bangAnimTrack:Stop() end
end

local function startBangAction(mode)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

    if (mode == "Back" or mode == "Face") and not bangAnimTrack then
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://148840333"
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            bangAnimTrack = hum:LoadAnimation(anim)
            bangAnimTrack.Looped = true
        end
    end

    if (mode == "Back" or mode == "Face") and bangAnimTrack and not bangAnimTrack.IsPlaying then 
        bangAnimTrack:Play() 
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local timer = 0
        while (_G.IsNormalBanging or _G.IsFaceBanging or _G.IsHeadSitting or _G.IsBackSitting) and _G.TargetPlayerObj and _G.TargetPlayerObj.Character and LocalPlayer.Character do
            local dt = task.wait()
            timer = timer + (dt * _G.BangSpeed)
            local moveOffset = math.sin(timer) * _G.BangIntensity

            local tRoot = _G.TargetPlayerObj.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local tHead = _G.TargetPlayerObj.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if myRoot then
                myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end

            if myRoot and tRoot then
                if mode == "Back" then
                    myRoot.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1 + moveOffset)
                elseif mode == "Face" then
                    if hum then hum.Sit = true end
                    myRoot.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.8, -1.2 - moveOffset) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)
                elseif mode == "HeadSit" and tHead then
                    if hum then hum.Sit = true end
                    myRoot.CFrame = tHead.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0)
                elseif mode == "BackSit" then
                    if hum then hum.Sit = true end
                    myRoot.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.2, 1.2) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)
                end
            end
        end
        if bangAnimTrack then bangAnimTrack:Stop() end
    end)
end

        end
    end

local function startOrbitEngine()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

    task.spawn(function()
        local angle = 0
        local lastSwitch = tick()
        local mapCenter = Vector3.new(math.random(-500, 500), math.random(10, 50), math.random(-500, 500))

        while (_G.IsOrbiting or _G.IsMapOrbiting) and char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") do
            local dt = task.wait()
            angle = angle + (dt * _G.OrbitSpeed)
            local offsetX = math.cos(angle) * _G.OrbitDistance
            local offsetZ = math.sin(angle) * _G.OrbitDistance

            local target = _G.TargetPlayerObj

            if _G.IsOrbiting and target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local targetPos = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
                local newPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(offsetX, 0, offsetZ)
                char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, targetPos)
            elseif _G.IsMapOrbiting then
                if tick() - lastSwitch >= 0.1 then
                    mapCenter = Vector3.new(math.random(-1000, 1000), math.random(10, 40), math.random(-1000, 1000))
                    lastSwitch = tick()
                end
                local newPos = mapCenter + Vector3.new(offsetX, 0, offsetZ)
                char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, mapCenter)
            end
        end
    end)
